notes: Tidier menu when you click someone's picture in the chat: just two small rows — their name with Infiltrate, Send points and Rock Paper Scissors as icons, then the emojis — and it springs open with the emojis popping in. Also: premium chat bubbles with proper artwork, click a bubble's picture to see it in a little chat, unlimited point gifts, and a much lighter chat.
